title: Book Notes: Atomic Habits
content:
Key takeaways:
1. Focus on systems rather than goals.
2. Small 1% improvements accumulate rapidly over time.
3. Make good habits obvious, attractive, easy, and satisfying.
4. Identity-based habits create long-term adherence.
